打开火山的剖面，看岩浆怎样向上走。试试一个喷口和多个喷口，再比较熔岩流与火山灰喷: Open a volcano in cross section. Follow rising magma, try one or several vents, and compare flowing lava with ash-rich eruptions.
打开多个喷口，看看岩浆是否只能从山顶出来。: Open several vents. Does magma have to emerge from the summit?
本次演示的喷口数量: Number of vents in this illustration
火山剖面；先看储存区受压、裂隙张开，再追踪岩浆上升。气泡、喷流与时间均为教学示意: Volcano cross section: first watch the storage region pressurize and fractures open, then follow rising magma. Bubbles, jets and time are illustrative.
地下供浆、岩浆浮力与压力差会让储存区受压；构造应力和原有裂隙决定岩脉更容易往哪里: Magma supply, buoyancy and pressure differences can pressurize a storage region; tectonic stress and existing fractures influence where dikes open most readily. Crustal movement does not trigger an eruption every time.
岩浆向上走时，周围压力降低，原本溶在里面的气体形成气泡并膨胀。: As magma rises, surrounding pressure falls. Dissolved gases form bubbles and expand.
岩浆到地表就叫熔岩。它可以从山顶喷出，也能从山坡或裂缝里的多个喷口出来。: Magma at the surface is called lava. It can emerge at the summit, on a flank or through several vents along cracks.
岩浆系统包含储存区、岩脉和通道。浮力、压力差、气体析出及构造条件共同影响运移与喷: Magma systems include storage regions, dikes and conduits. Buoyancy, pressure differences, gas exsolution and tectonic conditions influence magma transport and eruption.
上升减压促进挥发分出溶。高黏度岩浆通常更难让气体逸出，但实际行为还受温度、晶体含: Decompression promotes volatile exsolution. Viscous magma generally retains gas more readily, but temperature, crystals and supply rate also affect behavior.
富气且黏稠的岩浆更易发生碎裂和爆炸式喷发；流动性较强的岩浆常形成熔岩流或喷泉。这: Gas-rich, viscous magma is more prone to fragmentation and explosive eruption. More fluid magma often produces flows or fountains. This compares tendencies, not real eruption forecasts.
多个喷口可与分支通道或裂隙系统相连。本页在喷口间分配同一示意供给量，多喷口并不自: Multiple vents may connect to branching conduits or fissures. This illustration divides one notional supply among vents; more vents do not automatically multiply eruption energy.
试着把气体和黏稠程度调低，再调高，比较“向下流”和“向上喷”的不同。真实火山常把: Lower gas content and viscosity, then increase them. Compare downward flows and upward jets. Real volcanoes can combine several styles and change between eruptions.

容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
地下岩浆常以熔体、晶体与气体混合物存在于储存区和裂隙网络中。岩浆与围岩的密度差、: Subsurface magma is commonly a mixture of melt, crystals and gas within storage regions and fracture networks. Density contrast, reservoir pressure and tectonic stress help determine whether it rises through dikes and conduits.
ΔP_b 是高度 H 上的浮力压差估计；围岩比岩浆密时该项有利于上升。它不是完整: ΔP_b estimates buoyancy pressure over height H; denser host rock favors ascent. It is not a complete eruption criterion: conduit resistance and stress conditions also matter.
从下面的岩浆储存区，沿橙色通道往上找喷口。: Start at the magma storage region and trace the orange pathways to the vents.
储存区画成一个轮廓只是剖面示意；真实系统不一定是一个装满液体的巨大洞穴。: The single storage outline is schematic. Real systems need not be giant cavities full of liquid.
岩浆上升时压力降低，部分溶解挥发分可从熔体中出溶形成气泡。已有气泡也会随压力降低: As magma ascends and pressure falls, some dissolved volatiles exsolve into bubbles, while existing gas expands. Whether bubbles connect and escape influences degassing and the conditions for fragmentation.
此处只用理想气体关系说明：气体量 n 和温度 T 固定时，降压会增大体积 V。真: The ideal-gas relation only illustrates that decreasing P increases gas volume V at fixed gas amount n and temperature T. Both n and T can change in magma; this equation alone does not determine volatile solubility.
停在上升阶段，比较通道下部与上部气泡的大小。: Pause during ascent and compare bubbles lower and higher in the conduit.
气泡不是普通空气；火山气体可包括水汽、二氧化碳和二氧化硫等。: The bubbles are not ordinary air; volcanic gases can include water vapor, carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide.
黏度影响流动和气泡逸出，气体膨胀能驱动喷泉或使岩浆碎裂。温度、成分、晶体含量、上: Viscosity affects flow and bubble escape, while gas expansion can drive fountains or fragmentation. Temperature, composition, crystals, ascent rate and external water also matter: low-viscosity magma can erupt explosively, so one slider cannot classify real eruptions.
τ 为剪切应力，η 为动力黏度，γ̇ 为剪切速率。这是牛顿流体的参考关系；含晶体: τ is shear stress, η dynamic viscosity and γ̇ shear rate. This is a Newtonian reference relation; crystal- and bubble-bearing magma may depart strongly from it.
把气体和黏稠程度先调低、再调高，比较贴着山坡流动的熔岩和向上散开的物质。: Lower gas and viscosity, then raise them. Compare lava traveling down slopes with material ejected upward.
红橙色代表高温物质，不是普通火焰。火山灰是细小岩石、矿物和玻璃颗粒，也不是燃烧后: Red and orange represent hot material, not ordinary flame. Volcanic ash consists of fine rock, mineral and glass fragments, not combustion ash.
岩脉可沿裂隙侧向传播，让岩浆从山坡或裂缝上的多个位置到达地表。喷口之间分配同一系: Dikes can propagate laterally along fractures, allowing magma to reach the surface at multiple flank or fissure vents. Vents share supply from a system; more vents do not automatically multiply total erupted volume or hazard.
Q_i 是各喷口的体积流率。这里将固定的示意颗粒供给分给各喷口；真实分配受通道尺: Q_i is each vent’s volumetric flow rate. A fixed illustrative particle supply is divided among vents here; real partitioning depends on geometry, pressure and rheology and need not be equal.
冷却阶段的颜色变暗只表示表面降温趋势，不对应真实冷却时长；内部可能仍然很热。: Darkening during cooling indicates a surface trend, not a measured cooling time; interiors may remain hot.
熔滴上升后会落回地面: Lava clasts rise, then fall to the ground
气泡从热亮的喷口逸出: Gas escapes at the glowing vent
表层结壳，缝里仍有热熔岩: A surface crust forms above hot lava
变暗不等于里面已经凉了: A dark surface can still hide a hot interior
从地下通道追到地面喷口。: Trace the underground conduit to the surface vent.
保持同一时刻，放大看气泡、熔滴和落地飞溅。: Keep the same moment and inspect gas escape, clasts and spatter.
沿山坡看亮色通道、暗色表壳和较热的内部。: Inspect the bright channel, dark crust and hotter interior along the slope.
熔岩的表面先变暗、结成硬壳，里面却可能还很热。喷发减弱后，留下的熔岩继续慢慢冷却: The lava surface darkens and forms a crust first, while its interior may remain very hot. Deposited lava keeps cooling after the eruption wanes, and repeated eruptions change the volcano’s shape.
这是通道、气泡和喷口关系的教学剖面。三个镜头观察同一时刻，近景和熔岩厚度经过放大: This teaching cutaway connects conduits, gas and vents. Three views show the same moment; close-ups and flow thickness are exaggerated. Bright material beneath a dark crust indicates retained heat, not a temperature measurement. The model does not solve magma rheology, pressure, heat transfer or ash transport, and its duration is not a real cooling time. The sliders compare relative conditions and do not fully classify eruption styles.
切换到山坡熔岩近景，拖到冷却阶段，比较暗色表壳与缝隙里的余热；也可以切换喷口数量: Switch to the lava-slope close-up and scrub to cooling. Compare the dark crust with heat still visible in gaps; change the vent count to trace their shared source.
沿地下通道寻找岩浆: Trace the magma through its underground path
气体少时，熔岩以流出为主: With little gas, lava mainly flows out
此时岩浆还未到达喷口: Magma has not yet reached the opening
喷口开始出现高温物质: Hot material begins to reach the opening
喷口变暗，内部仍可能很热: The vent darkens; its interior may remain hot
看熔岩怎样跨过喷口边缘: Follow lava over the edge of the opening
此时地面还没有熔岩流: No lava flow is on the surface yet
亮色熔岩在暗色表壳之间流动: Bright lava moves between dark crust rafts
推进进度，等待岩浆到达地表: Advance time until magma reaches the surface
沿山坡追踪熔岩前缘: Follow the lava front down the slope
这组岩浆较容易流动，气体较容易释放。看它沿山坡摊开，亮色熔岩之间逐渐长出暗色硬壳: Here magma flows and releases gas more readily. Watch it spread downhill as dark crust grows between patches of glowing lava.
重点看：前缘走多远、流道有多宽，以及表壳下的余热。: Watch the advancing front, the channel width and heat retained beneath the crust.
容易流动的岩浆也能被膨胀气体带向空中。较粗的熔滴沿弧线落回山坡，周围仍可有熔岩流: Expanding gas can also lift fluid magma into the air. Coarse lava clasts follow arcs back to the slopes, alongside flowing lava.
重点看：喷泉高度、熔滴落点，与贴地熔岩的区别。: Compare fountain height, clast landing sites and lava moving along the ground.
这组条件更容易使岩浆碎裂。细灰随上升气体卷入空气，形成不断扩展的灰云，较粗的碎块: These conditions favor fragmentation. Rising gas and fine ash entrain air into an expanding cloud, while coarser fragments fall sooner.
重点看：灰柱扩展、向一侧漂移，以及细灰落在更远的地方。: Watch the plume expand and drift, with fine ash falling farther away.
熔岩、火山灰或其他碎屑正在出来，是当前喷发的证据。喷发可以以流动为主，也可以以爆: Lava, ash or other fragments being emitted are evidence of an ongoing eruption. It may be mostly effusive or explosive.
看实际喷出物，并结合地震、地表形变、气体与热观测。单独一缕白气不等于岩浆正在喷出: Observe erupted material together with earthquakes, ground deformation, gas and heat. A white plume alone does not show that magma is erupting.
“活火山”并不等于每天都在喷；目前正在喷发只是其中一种状态。: An active volcano need not erupt every day; ongoing eruption is one possible state.
休眠期：现在安静，仍可能再喷: Dormant: quiet now, but may erupt again
“休眠”常用来描述火山喷发之间的安静时期。过去的喷发层、年代和地下活动线索，让科: Dormant often describes a quiet interval between eruptions. Dated deposits and subsurface clues can indicate a system that may erupt again.
一起研究岩层年代、历史记录、地震、形变和气体；安静很久也不能只靠外观宣布它“死了: Study rock ages, historical records, earthquakes, deformation and gas together. A long quiet interval cannot establish extinction from appearance alone.
“休眠”的用法并不完全统一，很多休眠火山仍属于广义的活火山；没有统一的几年倒计时: Usage of dormant varies. Many dormant volcanoes are active in the broader sense; there is no universal countdown in years.
“死火山”通常指科学家根据地质历史和供浆背景，认为不太可能再次喷发的火山。它是一: Extinct usually describes a volcano judged unlikely to erupt again, based on its geological history and magma-supply setting. It is an evidence-based assessment that can be revised.
依据现有证据，不预期再喷: No further eruption expected from current evidence
需要较完整的地质年代和构造、岩浆供给背景，不能用山上长草、没有烟或某个固定年数代: Geological ages, tectonic setting and magma supply matter. Grass, a lack of visible emissions or a fixed number of years cannot replace that evidence.
长得安静不等于已熄灭；一处旧喷口不再活动，也不保证整个火山区不会出现新喷口。: Quiet appearance does not establish extinction. An old vent becoming inactive does not rule out a new vent elsewhere in its volcanic field.
选择富灰爆发，看上升扩展的灰云与下风方向的落灰。: Choose the ash-rich example to inspect the rising plume and ashfall downwind.
这幅图里能看到喷出物。: Erupted material is visible in this picture.
这幅山形保持不变：仅看外观，分不清休眠与熄灭。: This mountain picture stays unchanged: appearance alone cannot separate dormant from extinct.
比较熔岩流、熔岩喷泉和富灰爆发，再问一问：不喷发的火山，是在休息，还是已被认为熄: Compare lava flows, fountains and ash-rich eruptions. Then ask: is a quiet volcano between eruptions, or considered extinct?
01 / 同一时刻，比较喷发方式: 01 / COMPARE STYLES AT THE SAME MOMENT
先停在喷发时刻比较，再拖回地下看起。切换方式保留时间与观察角度；同一座火山也可能: Compare while paused during eruption, then rewind to the underground stage. Switching style preserves time and view; one volcano can also change eruption style.
灰云：细碎岩石与玻璃: Ash cloud: fine rock and glass
滑块是相对条件，不是火山爆发指数 VEI。增加喷口只是分配同一份供给。: Sliders express relative conditions, not the Volcanic Explosivity Index (VEI). More vents divide the same supply.
02 / 喷发方式与活动状态，是两回事: 02 / ERUPTION STYLE AND ACTIVITY STATUS DIFFER
山顶安静，就能叫“死火山”吗？: Does a quiet summit mean extinct?
这不是让火山瞬间“死去”的开关。换一组证据，看看科学家为什么会作出不同判断。: These controls compare evidence, rather than instantly extinguishing a volcano. Explore why different evidence supports different assessments.
同样安静的山形，不能单凭外观区分休眠与熄灭: The same quiet mountain cannot be classified as dormant or extinct by appearance alone
不是把这一轮喷发调大，山就立刻变陡: A larger eruption does not instantly make a steeper mountain
较易流动的熔岩多次铺开，可以建起宽而缓的山体；它也可能有爆炸性喷发。: Repeated flows of fluid lava can build broad, gentle slopes. Shield volcanoes can also erupt explosively.
多次熔岩与碎屑堆积形成复杂层次。山形不是这一次喷发强弱的刻度。: Repeated lava and fragment deposits build complex layers. The shape is not a gauge of the current eruption's intensity.
地下支撑条件改变时，地面可大范围塌陷。它不只是山顶被“炸飞”，有些后来会积水成湖: Changes in subsurface support can cause extensive collapse. A caldera is more than a summit being blown off; some later hold lakes.
海底火山怎样长成岛？ →: How can a submarine volcano build an island? →
保持同一喷发方式，只改变供给，看看流动范围或喷出物数量怎样变化。: Keep the same eruption style and change only supply. How do the flow extent and amount of ejecta change?
喷发方式、喷出规模和火山是否仍可能活动，是三个不同的问题。这里先比较流、喷泉和灰: Eruption style, output and the potential for future activity are different questions. Compare flows, fountains and ash clouds, then change supply within a style. Temperature, composition, crystals, conduits and external water also matter; real styles can mix or change. Explore seawater effects in the submarine-volcano topic.
四个镜头观察同一示意时刻，近景、厚度与时间经过缩放；颜色不用于测温。未求解真实流: Four views show the same illustrative moment. Close-ups, thickness and time are scaled; color is not a thermometer. The model does not solve rheology, pressure, heat transfer, plume or ash transport, or simulate pyroclastic density currents. Relative conditions are neither monitoring values nor a complete classifier. VEI primarily compares explosive ejecta volume, alongside plume evidence; it is not a single score for total energy, lava discharge or hazard. Activity status below uses separate long-term evidence, independent of this animation's time or supply.
熔岩铺出的宽山: A broad mountain built by lava
容易流动的熔岩一次次铺开，山体渐渐变宽。这里是一条概念性历史，不代表所有盾状火山: Repeated flows of fluid lava spread out and build a broad mountain. This is one conceptual history, not every shield volcano’s eruption style.
选“打开剖面”，看较宽的熔岩层怎样叠起来。: Open the cutaway and follow the broad layers of lava.
地下通道连向地面，新熔岩即将加入地表。: A pathway connects magma below ground to the surface, where new lava can arrive.
一层冷却岩石留了下来，下一层继续铺上去。宽缓的山体是许多次堆积的结果。: One cooled layer remains as another spreads over it. Many deposits build the broad, gentle mountain.
这个片段里的喷发结束了，留下的熔岩冷却成岩石。整个火山系统是否还会喷，要看更多证: The eruption in this sequence ends, leaving cooling rock. Whether the volcanic system can erupt again needs other evidence.
之后可以有土壤和植被，也可能被流水侵蚀。切换两种后来情境，看看原来的轮廓还剩多少: Later, soil and plants may develop, or running water may erode the mountain. Compare two possible later landscapes.
熔岩与碎屑叠起的山: A mountain of lava and fragments
熔岩与不同碎屑沉积共同建造山体。选择一次喷发，可以比较熔岩流、喷泉和富灰爆发。: Lava and fragment deposits build the mountain together. Zoom into an eruption to compare flows, fountains and ash-rich bursts.
同一座火山可以改变喷发方式，山形也不是危险程度的刻度。: One volcano can change eruption style. Shape is not a hazard scale.
岩浆沿裂隙上升；储存区和通道只占地下的一部分。: Magma rises through fractures; storage regions and conduits occupy only part of the subsurface.
熔岩与碎屑逐次留下不同的层。这里只选取一种堆积历史，并非每次喷发都严格交替。: Lava and fragments leave different layers over successive episodes. This selected history does not imply strict alternation in every eruption.
喷发间歇时山体还在，先前的沉积不会随火光消失。: Between eruptions the mountain remains. Earlier deposits do not vanish when the glow fades.
植被、风化和侵蚀继续改变山坡；塌陷也可能另造低洼地。继续看火山湖，研究凹地怎样蓄: Plants, weathering and erosion reshape the slopes; collapse may create a depression. Explore volcanic lakes to examine water retention.
碎屑堆成山，后来披上绿衣: Fragments build a cone, then plants arrive
以大室山为例认识火山渣锥：喷出的多孔碎屑落在喷口周围，山形在喷发时就已建立。画面: Use Omuroyama to explore a scoria cone: porous volcanic fragments collect around a vent, building its shape during eruption. The scene is conceptual, not a surveyed reconstruction.
今天大室山的草坡也与长期山烧管理有关，长草本身不能证明火山已熄灭。: Omuroyama’s present grassland is also maintained by traditional burning. Vegetation alone cannot establish extinction.
先有喷口，再有落回周围的碎屑；不是一座普通山忽然点起火。: A vent opens and fragments fall around it; this is not an ordinary mountain catching fire.
火山渣与火山弹落下、堆积，建立山坡和中央火山口。大室山的活动还曾让熔岩从山麓流出: Scoria and volcanic bombs accumulate into slopes around a crater. Omuroyama’s eruption also produced lava from the foot of the cone.
这一段喷发结束，锥形山与火山口已经留下。不能把这种山形当成所有死火山的模样。: This eruptive episode ends with the cone and crater already present. This is not a universal shape for extinct volcanoes.
土壤与植被后来覆盖山坡。大室山的草地还受人为山烧维护；旧喷口结束活动，也不代表整: Soil and vegetation later cover the slopes. Traditional burning maintains Omuroyama’s grassland; an inactive old vent does not rule out new vents in the volcanic field.
从海底熔岩到可能的岛屿: From seafloor lava to a possible island
海水改变熔岩的冷却和喷发环境。比较深水、浅水和长期成岛三个情境，它们不是每座海底: Seawater changes cooling and eruption conditions. Compare deep water, shallow water and long-term island building; they are not inevitable stages of every submarine volcano.
在成岛情境中改变供给历史，比较露出海面的山和始终留在水下的海山。: In the island case, compare sustained and limited supply: an island or a seamount that remains submerged.
岩浆来到海底喷口。深水、浅水与长期堆积分别选择了不同条件和时间尺度。: Magma reaches a seafloor vent. The three scenarios select different conditions and timescales.
深水例子里，熔岩外层迅速结壳，新的熔岩团块继续长出；浅水例子观察岩浆与水相互作用: In the deep example, lava skins solidify as new lobes grow; the shallow example explores magma–water interaction.
成岛需要足够多的物质堆积。只有部分海底火山能够长到海面以上，水下仍藏着巨大的山体: An island needs enough accumulated material. Only some submarine volcanoes reach the surface, with a large mountain still below water.
喷出的物质留下岩石；成岛片段最后还展示海浪侵蚀。热液活动与正在喷出熔岩是不同的事: Erupted material leaves rock; the island sequence also ends with wave erosion. Hydrothermal activity differs from an ongoing lava eruption.
火山口或塌陷形成的破火山口可以成为湖盆。能否积水，还取决于水的补给、渗漏和出口。: A crater or collapse caldera can provide a basin. Water accumulation also depends on supply, leakage and outlets.
把补给调低或增加渗漏：即使有凹地，也不一定留得住湖水。: Reduce water supply or increase leakage: even a basin may fail to retain a lake.
选择较小火山口或塌陷破火山口。后者先观察岩浆撤出，岩体还没有立即下沉。: Choose a smaller crater or collapse caldera. For the latter, first watch magma withdrawal before the ground subsides.

喷发、冷却、积水和热液活动是不同过程；这些过程可能在同一个火山系统里先后或同时发: Eruption, cooling, water accumulation and hydrothermal activity are different processes. They may occur in sequence or together within a volcanic system.

亮色熔体穿过暗色晶体；细虚线是尚未张开的裂隙。下方补给进入 → 局部增压 → 岩: Bright melt threads through darker crystals; fine dashed lines mark unopened fractures. Recharge enters below → local pressure rises → a dike propagates → eruption follows connection.
这里演示补给驱动的一种路径。条形是相对示意，不是仪器读数；构造张裂等其他机制也可: This illustrates one recharge-driven pathway. Bars are relative indicators, not instrument readings. Other mechanisms, including tectonic extension, can also promote ascent.
试着减少补给或增大岩层阻碍，再从头播放：这次还会喷发吗？: Reduce the supply or increase rock barriers, then replay: will an eruption still occur?
深部岩石发生部分熔融，熔体汇集后沿裂隙上升。画面下边缘是从更深处进入的补给；这里: Deep rocks partially melt; the melt collects and rises along fractures. Recharge enters from greater depth at the bottom of this section. The whole mantle is not shown, and lava is not supplied by the core.
新的岩浆进入已有储存区，改变局部压力并挤压周围岩石。储存区包含熔体和晶体，有不同: New magma enters existing storage, changing local pressure and stressing surrounding rock. Melt and crystals occupy connected regions and lens-shaped sills at different depths, rather than one spherical tank of liquid.
岩浆沿有利的裂隙侵入，把岩脉尖端向前推进；短分支可以停在地下。围岩应力、结构阻碍: Magma intrudes along favorable fractures, advancing a dike tip; short branches may stop underground. Host-rock stress, structural barriers and buoyancy affect the path. Falling pressure during ascent allows gas to exsolve and bubbles to expand.
这一次岩脉终于通达地表，喷出物才开始出现。气体能否顺利逸出、岩浆黏度和补给共同影: In this episode, the dike reaches the surface before erupted material appears. Gas escape, magma viscosity and supply affect whether lava flows, fountains or an ash-rich eruption develop. Magma discharge also reduces reservoir overpressure.
这次岩浆停在了地下，未贯通地表。补给减弱后，侵入的岩脉与岩床逐渐冷却结晶；有增压: This intrusion stopped underground without reaching the surface. As supply wanes, its dikes and sills slowly cool and crystallize. Pressure changes, fractures and unrest do not guarantee eruption.
这次补给不足以推动岩浆贯通地表。岩浆仍可留在储存区，随后缓慢冷却；地面保持安静，: Recharge in this case cannot drive magma to the surface. Magma can remain in storage and cool slowly. A quiet surface does not establish that the whole volcanic system is extinct.
这一情境中，深部补给逐渐减弱，排出与散失使过压下降，喷发随之减弱。已经喷出的碎屑: Here, deep supply wanes; discharge and losses reduce overpressure and the eruption weakens. Previously emitted fragments keep moving and landing, while lava remains on the slope.
喷出的熔岩与碎屑留下新的岩石；未喷出的部分留在地下。暗色表皮不代表内部已经冷透，: Erupted lava and fragments leave new rock; unerupted material remains below. A dark skin does not mean a cold interior. Underground crystallization and surface cooling both take time.

先追踪下方补给和向上推进的岩脉尖端，再比较过压与贯通程度。地下有活动，地表却可以: Follow recharge from below and the advancing dike tip, then compare overpressure with propagation. Underground activity can occur without any surface ejecta.
喷发结束了，小山还在。刚留下的岩石可能很热，小苗还不能在这里安家。先看红光慢慢退: The eruption has ended, but the mountain remains. Fresh rock can be too hot for seedlings. Watch the glow fade: even when the skin turns dark, the inside may still be hot.
雨水、冷热变化和生物活动慢慢改变岩石。裂缝接住碎粒、风吹来的尘土和水；枯叶等有机: Rain, temperature changes and living organisms slowly alter rock. Cracks collect grains, windblown dust and water; organic material such as dead leaves can join them later. These pockets often offer the first small places to take hold.
风或动物把种子带来，一些孢子也能远行。来到这里还不够：需要合适的温度、水和能够扎: Wind or animals bring seeds, and some spores travel far too. Arrival alone is not enough: seedlings need suitable warmth, water and places for roots. Look closely: they establish in favorable patches, rather than turning the whole mountain green at once.
种子来了，水却留不住。干旱、薄土和容易漏水的碎屑，让许多小苗难以活下来。看到大片: Seeds arrive, but water is scarce or drains away. Drought, thin soil and freely draining fragments make survival difficult. Large areas of bare rock need not be newly erupted; recovery can be very slow.
高处太冷，能生长的季节很短。这里仍可能有耐寒的小植物，但很难长成连片绿坡。有的山: High slopes can be cold with short growing seasons. Hardy little plants may survive, but continuous cover is difficult. A mountain may have green lower slopes and a bare summit.
刚长起的小苗又被厚厚的新火山灰盖住了，一部分植被和原来的表土被埋在下面。新的熔岩: New seedlings are covered by a thick layer of fresh ash, burying some plants and the old soil. New lava, thick ash or unstable slopes can interrupt recovery; it does not always move forward.
水分和温度合适，地面也较稳定，小苗逐渐增多，枯落物又帮助土壤积累。绿色先连成斑块: With suitable moisture, warmth and stable ground, more seedlings establish. Dead plant material helps soil accumulate. Green patches gradually spread, but each mountain takes a different amount of time and need not become a forest.

大室山为什么像一顶草帽？它先由火山渣堆成山，后来才有植物。今天的草坡还受到长期人: Why does Omuroyama look like a grassy hat? Scoria built its cone before plants arrived. Traditional controlled burning also maintains its grassland today; grass cannot simply be explained by calling the volcano dead. These are general environmental comparisons, not a measured reconstruction of Omuroyama’s recovery.
